text: Three Tunisian journalism students, Yasmine, Walid and Bilel, take up a cold case for a school film project. They interview Mongia, the mutilated survivor of an attack twenty years ago, in a mental hospital, and [her story leads them|trigger|digging into a mystery] to [an isolated village|images|buildings and public places], where before they understand what is happening they are [surrounded by cannibal witches|threat|witchcraft and cursed things].
